# Indusagi

## About
Indusagi is a fast, open-source TypeScript AI agent framework and terminal-first Coding Agent CLI. It lets developers build powerful custom AI agents with full control over memory, tools, streaming, MCP servers, and TUI interfaces.

## What We Offer
- **Indusagi Package** — Complete TypeScript SDK for building AI agents (providers, agent loop, memory, tools, TUI widgets)
- **Coding Agent CLI** — Powerful terminal AI coding assistant with extensions, skills, hooks, sessions, RPC, and SDK modes
- **Open Source** — Fully open-source, MIT licensed, actively maintained

## Key Features
- TypeScript-first with full type safety
- Multi-provider AI support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok, local models, etc.)
- Advanced memory system with semantic search and long-term storage
- MCP server integration
- Beautiful Terminal UI (TUI) components
- Streaming, tools, background agents, sub-agents
- Session management, compaction, and smart context handling

## Who It's For
- Developers building AI agents
- Teams that want a self-hosted/open-source coding agent
- Anyone tired of slow or limited commercial AI coding tools
- TypeScript / Next.js / Node.js developers

## Frequently Asked Questions
- What is Indusagi? → Open-source TypeScript AI agent framework + terminal coding agent.
- Is it free? → Yes, fully open-source and free.
- Does it support local models? → Yes, plus all major cloud providers.
- Can I use it in production? → Yes, many developers already do.
